description: We are a team of five who think differently and turn new ideas into real solutions. We combine software and hardware in the medical field to keep astronauts healthy and safe in space. We believe every great idea starts with “What if?” and use teamwork and creativity to make space travel safer.
summary:
Remontada Health System is an intelligent health monitoring platform designed to support astronauts during long-duration space missions. It addresses the physical and mental health risks caused by space radiation, isolation, altered gravity, and the challenges of living in space.

The system combines health monitoring, an interactive virtual clinic, mental health support, and computer vision to help astronauts track their health, identify potential health concerns, and receive preliminary guidance. It also uses gamification elements to encourage astronauts to complete health-related tasks and maintain healthy habits.

Our goal is to empower astronauts to take a more active role in managing their health, especially when immediate medical assistance from Earth is limited.
details:
Project Overview

Remontada Health System is a web-based health monitoring platform designed to help astronauts monitor and manage their physical and mental well-being during long-duration space missions.

The platform addresses the challenges of healthcare in space, where astronauts face limited access to immediate medical assistance and must take greater responsibility for monitoring their own health.

_____________________

Main Features

1. Dynamic Health Dashboard

The dashboard presents important health indicators, including blood pressure, heart rate, blood glucose, and body temperature. It is designed to display sensor data through interactive dynamic charts, allowing astronauts to track changes in their health indicators over time.

2. Virtual Clinic

The Virtual Clinic provides an interactive human body model. Astronauts can select the body part where they experience pain or discomfort. The system then asks relevant questions about their symptoms and analyzes their answers to provide a preliminary health assessment and appropriate guidance.

3. Mental Health Support

This module focuses on astronauts' psychological well-being and includes:

Sleep monitoring based on daily sleep hours.

Interactive sleep-related chat.

Daily journal cards for recording thoughts and feelings.

Motivational cards to encourage positive habits.

Mental games to support cognitive engagement.

4. Computer Vision

This feature usescamera-based eye detection and analysis to identify potential visual signs of fatigue, eye strain, and drowsiness, supporting the monitoring of astronauts' well-being.

________________________

How It Helps

By combining physical and mental health monitoring in one platform, Remontada helps astronauts become more aware of their health status. It encourages early attention to potential health concerns and provides accessible guidance to support better health decisions.

Gamification is included as a motivational element to encourage astronauts to complete health-related tasks and maintain consistent self-care habits.

______________________

Expected Impact

We aim to improve astronauts' ability to monitor their health independently, recognize potential health changes, and maintain healthier routines throughout long-duration space missions.

The project may also inspire similar healthcare solutions for people living in remote areas with limited access to medical services.

________________________

Technologies and Tools

The Remontada Health System website was developed and deployed using the following technologies and tools:

HTML: Used to structure the website and organize its content.

CSS: Used to design the user interface and style the website.

JavaScript: Used to implement interactive features and dynamic functionality.

Google Gemini:Used to support AI-powered interactions and intelligent assistance.

Netlify: Used to deploy and host the website, making it accessible online.
